Dual pool pattern: GestorDePools in pools.rs owns two Mutex-wrapped connection pairs (1 r/w + 1 ro for sessions.db, 2 ro for knowledge_live.db), all connections set journal_mode=WAL, busy_timeout=5000ms, synchronous=NORMAL, foreign_keys=ON with justifications at call sites
Versioned migrations: migraciones.rs reads PRAGMA user_version, applies embeded SQL (via include_str!) within single transaction, re-run is no-op, no external migration crate

Persistence: RepositorioDeSesiones repository persists dedup via estado_del_motor with ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET valor=max(valor,excluded.valor) for monotonic horizon across restarts; history (mensajes table) survives process restart; semantics unchanged (max received timestamp, not system clock)

Readiness: evaluar_preparacion pure function takes three args (vitalidad pools, SesionDelCanal), returns true only if all three healthy; vitality probe checks both Path::exists AND cheap SQL query (confirmed on Linux that query alone insufficient); /health/ready returns 503 on not-ready, /health/live stays 200 always

tempfile rejected: temp_dir()+process::id() pattern already established in HEX-004 tests
